NFL DFS Defense Rankings: Week 12 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 29 · 9 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 24, 5:28 PM ET

The Jaguars are the top-projected defense on the Week 12 DraftKings main slate at 8.0 DraftKings points for $4,000, against Tennessee. Chargers (7.3, $2,900) and Commanders (7.3, $3,200) are next.

The Patriots return the most per dollar among defenses projected for at least 6 points: 2.66 projected points per $1,000 at $2,700.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 24, 5:28 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Defenses to know in Week 12

Jaguars, JAX vs TEN ($4,000)

Jaguars carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 8.0 DraftKings points at $4,000. That is 0.7 points clear of Chargers. The salary works out to 2.00 projected points per $1,000, 7th of 9 at the position. Across 50,000 simulations Jaguars averaged 8.1 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 16.0, and it holds 1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Jacksonville is a 14.5-point favorite at home against Tennessee, with an implied team total of 31 in a game totaled at 47.5.

Value: Patriots, NE at LAC ($2,700)

Patriots projects for 7.2 DraftKings points at $2,700, which works out to 2.66 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 9 defenses the model projects for 6 or more points. Across 50,000 simulations Patriots averaged 7.3 points with a simulated floor of -0.3 and a ceiling of 15.6, and it holds 15% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. New England is a 1.5-point underdog on the road against the Chargers, with an implied team total of 17 in a game totaled at 35.5.
